marks.gloss_en: the baraita: [that all watches are equal in the shewbread] is derived from 'they shall eat portion like portion' (Deut 18:8)
the baraita: the watches are NOT equal in obligations brought on the festival that do not come on account of the festival
[and it sacrifices all] -- to include what? to include the 'summer fruit' of the altar
the mishnah: a Festival adjacent to Shabbat, whether before it or after it -- all the watches were equal in the distribution of the shewbread
(entertained) 'before it' is the first Festival day, 'after it' the last Festival day
rather: 'before it' is the last Festival day, 'after it' the first Festival day
the incoming divide in the north
[the other communal offerings] -- to include what? to include the bull for a communal matter hidden [from the court]
אמר לך רב: תנאי היא -- דתניא: הילך מצה הילך חמץ; אבא שאול אומר: הילך חמץ הילך מצה. The mishnah's order is one side of a tannaitic dispute (m_hilach), so it does not refute Rav
Abba Shaul: here is chametz for you, here is matza for you
והלכתא: סוכה, ואחר כך זמן -- the redactor rules with Rav, against Rav Nachman bar Rav Chisda's דרש; coherent with the blunted teyuvta. Verdict-inert.
Rav: [one says the blessing of] the sukkah, and afterwards [the blessing of] the time
Rav: the obligation of the day takes precedence
(entertained) Rav and Rabba bar bar Chana dispute in the dispute of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel
Beit Shammai: for the day causes the wine to come
Rav: Beit Hillel said [wine first] there only because the wine causes the kiddush to be said
Rabba bar bar Chana: Beit Shammai said [the day first] there only because the day causes the wine to come
the stam: here [on Shavuot] the chametz is primary and the matza secondary
